給.meaning: salary, supply, provide — appears in 給料 (salary)
給.label: noun

料.meaning: fee, materials, charge — common suffix (料金, 授業料)
料.label: noun-suffix

教.reading: キョウ, おし(える), おそ(わる)
教.label: verb

飯.meaning: cooked rice, meal — ご飯 (ごはん)
飯.label: noun

杯.meaning: cup, glass (counter for drinks) — sound changes: 一杯 いっぱい, 三杯 さんばい
杯.label: counter

暑.meaning: hot (weather only) — contrast with 熱い (hot objects)
暑.label: i-adjective

気.meaning: spirit, mood, feeling, air — 元気, 天気, 病気
気.label: noun

熱.meaning: heat, fever, hot (to touch) — same あつい reading as 暑い but different use
熱.label: i-adjective

厚.meaning: thick, deep (gratitude) — third あつい reading (厚い／熱い／暑い trap)
厚.label: i-adjective

篤.meaning: deep, serious, cordial — rare; fourth あつい reading (illness/sincerity)
篤.label: i-adjective

寒.meaning: cold (weather only) — contrast with 冷たい (cold objects)
寒.label: i-adjective

冷.reading: レイ, つめ(たい), ひ(える), さ(める)
冷.label: i-adjective

易.reading: エキ, イ, やさ(しい)
易.meaning: easy — same やさしい reading as 優しい (kind); context disambiguates
易.label: i-adjective

面.reading: メン, おも, つら
面.label: noun

嫌.reading: ケン, きら(い), いや
嫌.label: na-adjective

上.reading: ジョウ, うえ, あ(げる), のぼ(る)
上.label: direction

部.meaning: department, part, section, club — 部屋 (room)
部.label: noun

屋.meaning: shop, store, roof — suffix for shops (本屋, 花屋)
屋.label: noun-suffix

好.reading: コウ, す(き), この(む)
好.label: na-adjective

元.reading: ゲン, ガン, もと
元.label: noun

親.reading: シン, おや, した(しい)
親.label: noun

切.reading: セツ, サイ, き(る)
切.label: verb

理.meaning: reason, logic, principle — 料理 (cooking), 無理 (impossible)
理.label: noun

姉.meaning: older sister — お姉さん (おねえさん, irregular)
姉.label: noun

難.reading: ナン, むずか(しい), かた(い)
難.label: i-adjective

小.reading: ショウ, ちい(さい), こ, お
小.label: i-adjective

変.reading: ヘン, か(わる), か(える)
変.meaning: strange, change — 大変 (たいへん, very/terrible)
変.label: na-adjective

辞.meaning: resign, quit, word — 辞書 (dictionary), 辞典
辞.label: noun

賃.meaning: fare, fee, wages, rent — 家賃 (rent), 運賃 (fare)
賃.label: noun

計.meaning: measure, plan, total — 時計 (clock), 合計 (total)
計.label: noun

便.reading: ベン, ビン, たよ(り)
便.meaning: convenience, mail, flight — 便利 (べんり, convenient)
便.label: noun

利.meaning: advantage, benefit, profit — 便利, 利用
利.label: noun

空.reading: クウ, そら, あ(く), から
空.meaning: sky, empty, vacant — 空気 (air), 空港 (airport)
空.label: noun

下.reading: カ, ゲ, した, さ(げる), くだ(る)
下.label: direction

誕.meaning: birth, be born — almost always in 誕生日 (たんじょうび, birthday)
誕.label: noun

散.meaning: scatter, disperse — 散歩 (さんぽ, walk/stroll)
散.label: verb

歌.reading: カ, うた, うた(う)
歌.label: noun

良.meaning: good, fine — formal version of いい
良.label: i-adjective

若.reading: ジャク, わか(い), も(しくは)
若.label: i-adjective

懸.reading: ケン, ケ, か(ける)
懸.meaning: hang, suspend, depend on — 一生懸命 (with all one's might)
懸.label: verb

命.reading: メイ, ミョウ, いのち
命.meaning: life, command, fate — 一生懸命
命.label: noun

貸します.meaning: to lend (polite) — dictionary form: 貸す. Subject lends TO someone
貸します.label: verb-godan

借ります.meaning: to borrow, to rent (polite) — dictionary form: 借りる. Subject borrows FROM someone
借ります.label: verb-ichidan

習います.meaning: to learn (polite) — dictionary form: 習う. Often paired with に (teacher) or で (place)
習います.label: verb-godan

もう一杯.meaning: one more cup/glass — note sound change: 一杯 is いっぱい, NOT いちはい
もう一杯.label: phrase

古い.meaning: old (for objects only — never for people; use 年寄り or 年上 for people)
古い.label: i-adjective

高い.meaning: tall, high, expensive — opposite depends on context: 低い (low) or 安い (cheap)
高い.label: i-adjective

暑い.meaning: hot (weather/climate only) — exception trap: 熱い for objects, 厚い for thickness, all read あつい
暑い.label: i-adjective

寒い.meaning: cold (weather only) — for cold objects/drinks use 冷たい
寒い.label: i-adjective

冷たい.meaning: cold (to the touch), cold-hearted — for weather use 寒い
冷たい.label: i-adjective

易しい.meaning: easy, simple — exception: same reading as 優しい (kind/gentle); context decides
易しい.label: i-adjective

嫌い.meaning: dislike, hate — exception trap: ends in い but is a な-adjective, NOT い-adjective
嫌い.label: na-adjective

上手.meaning: skillful, good at — exception: NOT うえて or じょうて. Opposite: 下手 (へた)
上手.label: na-adjective

大きい.meaning: big, large — note long おお, not お
大きい.label: i-adjective

静か.meaning: quiet, calm — exception trap: な-adjective despite no い ending (uses 静かな/静かに)
静か.label: na-adjective
